lines.text: The Span has one problem. It is too perfect. A single load path. Nothing behind it.
Foreman Orrin has a faster fix. He wants the Span tuned to the rig. That makes it worse.
What do you want from me?
I want you to choose between a monument and a mending. I have not decided myself. That is why I need you to.
He asked you for an opinion.
I asked for a choice. They are not the same.
